title: Choose RandoMeet's new visual world
question: The roll assigned Night Sleeper. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll. Fonts stay Outfit + Plus Jakarta Sans in every option.

options.label: Night Sleeper
options.lineage: overnight sleeper trains: the shared compartment with a stranger
options.thesis: Every chat is a shared compartment on a night train: a stranger across from you, a few hours, maybe a friend by morning.
options.viewport: Match tab: green-black carriage ground, your avatar and a single saffron Find a Match button in thumb reach; while searching, a departures-board row flaps letter by letter and lands on the stranger's name.
options.risk: Can tip into a train costume (rivets, tickets everywhere) if the world goes beyond palette, density and the one board move.

raised.raise: Every surface comes from one stepped green tonal ramp; no ad-hoc translucent fills.
States are drawn marks (hairline at rest, filled when pressed, struck when disabled), never glows.
One 8px grid under every screen; layouts reflow by whole cells.
While a chat is live, everything else in the app recedes to the lowest ramp step.
A strict type scale with few, clearly separated steps.

options.label: Late-Night Call-In
options.thesis: You're on the air: random callers in the small hours, and the regulars the host knows by name.
options.viewport: Match tab: a horizontal tuning dial sweeps while searching and locks on a caller; a small red ON AIR lamp marks a live chat in the header.
options.risk: Familiar: night-blue with a warm accent is close to where many dark chat apps land.

options.label: Midnight Transit Map
options.lineage: metro diagrams fired as midnight-blue enamel
options.thesis: Every person you've met is a line; friendships are interchanges where lines meet.
options.viewport: Match tab: your line runs down the screen; the match lands as a new coloured line meeting yours at an interchange circle.
options.case: Fuses well: everyone reads a metro map; loses on clarity because chat is not a route.
options.risk: Line colours per person can read busy and abstract on small chat screens.

options.label: Streaming Title Wall
options.thesis: People as rows of poster tiles that grow on focus.
options.case: Turns people into browsable content, against safe-by-default.
options.kept: The live thing in focus; everything else recedes.

options.label: Darkroom Exposure Record
options.case: Lonely late-night users don't recognise a darkroom; hatching obscures chat.
options.kept: One stepped tonal ramp as the only surface tokens.

options.label: Centre-Rail Reference Setting
options.thesis: Twin columns around a rail of keys.
options.viewport: Two columns and a centre rail.
options.case: Scholarly and corporate-feeling; wrong for 2am company.
options.kept: States drawn as marks, not effects.

options.label: Crouwel Grid Specimen
options.thesis: Letterforms built on a visible grid.
options.case: A poster system; chat screens gain nothing from visible construction.

options.label: Emigre Bitmap Specimen
options.case: Conflicts with the pinned fonts and reads retro-toy.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A dark messenger like iMessage or WhatsApp, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Plain dark list and chat screens with one blue accent.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other messenger by design.
